cards.title: Halloween Magic: Creating Moments With Kids
cards.body: From ancient Samhain to modern celebrations, Halloween offers parents a chance to create meaningful autumn traditions. Ditching cynicism and embracing pumpkins, decorations, and spooky fun can transform the season into genuine connection time with children.

cards.title: Working Parents: School Holidays Logistics
cards.body: The 3pm school day end time creates a real challenge for working parents juggling schedules and life admin. Reimagining school holidays as actual family time rather than another logistical nightmare could transform how parents and kids spend time together.

cards.title: Talking to Kids About Politics
cards.body: With elections and political discourse everywhere, parents face questions about whether and how to discuss politics with children. Now is an important time to consider thoughtful approaches to these conversations.

cards.title: Parental Gaslighting and Child Depression
cards.body: Research reveals a concerning link between gaslighting in parent-child relationships and depression in youth. Understanding how self-blame mediates this relationship can help parents recognize harmful patterns.

cards.title: Building Accountability Without Creating Monsters
cards.body: Parents often confuse sympathy with empathy, undermining children's development of accountability and resilience. Curating genuine accountability helps children build the qualities needed for success.

cards.title: Why Gen Z Won't Answer Calls
cards.body: Phone calls feel overwhelming and anxiety-inducing to Generation Z, unlike their parents. Understanding this perspective can help bridge generational communication gaps with practical compromises.

cards.title: When Parents Have Conflict: What to Tell Kids
cards.body: Children sense parental tension even when parents try to hide it. Honest communication about difficulties, rather than silence and mystery, helps children process and cope with family stress.
